reconstruction.preprocessing: Identical original BGR decode, TUM calibration undistort, crop x16/y8 from640x480 to608x464, no resize/channel reorder; normalize FP32 2*(BGR/255)-.5. Reuse v30 encoder singleton session, frozen /4 outputs, CPU ORT_DISABLE_ALL and4/1 threads. Batch all17 images together would change the frozen encoder invocation contract.
reconstruction.centers: centers=patches[0,:,0:2,1,1].reshape(17,96,2).astype(int64), only after exact integer/grid/interior checks. In feature-grid units; no multiply/divide4 or half-pixel/color offset. Duplicate centers are legal and must remain in original patch order.
reconstruction.encoder_call: encode(cropped_BGR,centers=centers[slot].copy(),generator=None,patch_count=96), or same pure features_to_patches after singletonCNN. No new RNG/depth seeding or motion admission.
reconstruction.features: fmap[17,128,116,152]; gmap[1,1632,128,3,3]; per-frame context[96,384], flattened retained-view-major to context_all[1,1632,384].
reconstruction.context_lookup: inp=context_all[:,kk,:]; exactly per-edge original imap[:,kk], equivalent context[kk//96,kk%96]. Do not use context[ii], target jj, or compact/native kk for neural Update.
reconstruction.geometry: Use each snapshot original poses[1,17,7] world-to-camera xyzw, patches optimized inverse depth z and K[1,17,4] feature pixels unchanged. Newly returned Patchifier unit-depth patches are only XY validation and must not overwrite saved optimized z. Reproject complete3x3 patch to coords[1,23520,2,3,3] for native correlation; no BA or lifecycle mutation needed.
reconstruction.correlation: Use original ordered ii/jj/kk; native gmap index kk and target fmap index jj, levels1/4, radius3, 882 outputs in original patch/offset/level order. All17source/target slots occur here. Compact indices must map back to original neural/group IDs; retain explicit feature-generation key and owned copies.
reconstruction.net: Use saved nonzero net[1,23520,384] as new step input. Copy on each method/repeat; do not mutate snapshots or replace with zero hidden state.
reconstruction.shared_before_after_features: Actual before/final XY, K and ordered ii/jj/kk are equal; only the same frame/patch feature bundle may be shared. Poses, optimized z, net and therefore reprojection/correlation must use their own state version.

comparison.neural_semantics: Original sequential norm -> c1(neighbor-masked currentnet) add -> c2(from already c1-updated net) add -> SoftAgg kk add -> SoftAgg ii*12345+jj add -> two sequential GatedResidual -> d/w. comparison.gate: Every net/delta/weight element finite and original fixed rtol1e-4/atol1e-5 vs the original Torch one-step output; independent weight[0,1] check also required. No clipping or relaxed tolerance.
